source: Connected production PostgreSQL 17.11.0.003 read-only pg_depend and pg_describe_object
fingerprint: PostgreSQL md5 of pipe-concatenated seven catalog key fields and two pg_describe_object strings
assessment: All 800 actual catalog relationships captured with source and target full identity, typed edge behavior and MD5; first-party FK constraints and provider pg_stat rewrite/view references encountered. No reference failed description; no standalone safe deletion or security exploit established. Rule-typed catalog semantics are NOT a reread of SQL bodies/compiled implementations or a user-session authorization test.
limitations: Direct identity and dependency-edge classification only, not source-code/SQL-body semantic certification of the referenced objects.
`unqualified_or_other` may include public-schema objects; pg_catalog object IDs and pg_describe_object strings are retained as authoritative.
No private member/Auth identities, shots, notes, secrets or raw sensitive logs accessed; no provider writes.
FK/dependency edges do not independently demonstrate query latency or prove missing indexes should be added; only source/caller/testing can justify changes.
